about_the_game:
Build your deck. Command the battlefield. Seize victory! Battles of Cardista is a fresh, strategic card battler where solo campaigns meet competitive PvP in a richly unique world!

Welcome to Cardista, a lawless archipelago where factions all around the world come seeking myths, gold and fame!

Each faction boasts its own campaign with unique mechanics, challenges, lore and flavor.

Empire of the Blazing Crown

By pike and shot, the worshipers of the Sun God seek glory in the name of the crown, and crowns shine brighter with looted jewels.

Goblin Tide

Goblin Tide reaches the shores of Cardista looking for ever more scrap; they show their trickster nature in an endless wave!

Pirate Republic

The free folks of the archipelago answer only to themselves, and maybe the First Mate. They plunder that booty when they have the advantage, and look to equalize when they do not.

Lunar Sultanate

Desert elves worshiping the Moon Goddess, they attack swiftly and disappear like a mirage before their prey can react!

Battles of Cardista delivers a fresh card battler experience by blending elements inspired by Marvel Snap and Thronebreaker with its own unique mechanics and twists.

Unique Gameplay

Control the battlefield, separated into three sections. Navigate each terrain's effects and deploy the right troops on the right section.

Each section engages in either Skirmish or Melee; managing this state to your advantage is key to victory! A commander must know when to charge in and when to withdraw.

Simultaneous turns keep the game flowing while each side has to anticipate the opponent in a tactical face-off.

Campaign & PvP Modes

Solo: Embark on 4 separate roguelike adventures. Fight and loot, move island to island, upgrade your camp and cards, and face rival lords! Each faction has its own unique resources and mechanics.

Multiplayer: Build your deck and face other players in fast paced tactical matches.

What to Expect

Deep Variety: Each faction feels truly different; lord abilities and upgradable cards offer multiple playstyles, and procedurally generated campaigns provide replayability.

Fast & Engaging Matches: Meaningful decisions, evolving board states, and 5 minute matches that make you want to play one more.

A Unique, Living World: Step into this flavorful early modern fantasy setting, brought to life by beautiful artwork from artists around the world.

Deck up and step into the world of Cardista. Wishlist now and don't miss an update!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64‑bit
  • Processor: Dual-core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or entry-level dedicated card with ~1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Same or newer
  • Processor: Quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern GPU with ~2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
